title: Fix Agent List and Agent Task List filter and refresh issues (AB#646062)
summary: Fixed filter visibility and refresh issues on Agent List and Agent Task List pages by moving system-managed filters from the user-owned filter group to the server-owned filter group, and updated the Archive action guard to re-read the agent state from the database instead of relying on cached page data.
key_points: Moved Agent List toggle filters (Show all agents, Show agents for all companies) from filter group 0 to group 2 so they properly control the result set
Fixed Archive action guard on Agent List to call Agent.IsActive instead of reading cached Rec.State, ensuring it reflects the current database value
Modified Agent Task List to skip the archived agent substate filter when opened for a specific agent, preventing empty lists when viewing tasks for an archived agent
Moved Agent Task List toggle filter (Show tasks from all agents) to filter group 2 for proper effect
System-managed filters are now invisible and non-removable in the filter pane, with toggles as the only control method
